output.summary: The function fn_01 computes a checksum using a variant of the CRC-32 algorithm.

claims.text: Computes a checksum using a variant of the CRC-32 algorithm.
The initial value of the hash is 0xffffffff.
Iterates over each byte in the input buffer.
Performs a loop of 8 iterations for each byte.
Writes the final checksum to the output buffer.
Returns the final checksum as a 64-bit unsigned integer.
